praises: Same full-TGP RTX 5070 as the pricier Intel tiers — identical gaming FPS

32GB/1TB from the factory with both SODIMM and M.2 slots still upgradeable

$100 more than the anchor 275HX/5070/32GB/2TB/240Hz HDR tier for a worse screen — odd value curve

design_philosophy: The AMD trim of the 2025 Strix G16: a high-core-count Ryzen 8940HX with the same full-wattage RTX 5070, aimed at buyers who want CPU-heavy productivity alongside gaming, though the CA SKU pairs it with the base 165Hz panel.
